blocks.content: CAFE uses several Discord bots to manage our scheduling, runs, and general information. This section contains the complete reference for all bot commands. If you need help with a specific command or have questions about how to use the bots, please check the the links below or ask in <#1327327629090750504>.
- Proto-Ozma - Out resident scheduling and raid management bot
- Raiden - Our bot for voice channel management and several quality of life features
- CAFE Roster Manager - CAFE's exclusive drag-and-drop Discord Activity for roster building and management, used for Forked Tower and DRS signups.
